spec.description:
Objective: set up the deployment for a NEW small backend to our sandbox VM using the SAME deployment approach the Revealer sandbox project (revealer-6978) already uses, but this one must NOT run database migrations on every deploy, and it uses its own folder and port 4200. PREPARE THE DEPLOY SETUP ONLY — do NOT deploy now.

This is the second sandbox in this series (rep 5). It mirrors how revealer-6978 and backend-sandbox-rep-4 work: the deploy engine itself stays shared and generic (shared/infra/deploy_changes.py); only project-specific values live in a per-project delta (deploy/deploy-config.json + deploy/backend-sandbox-rep-5.config.sh under the project folder).

Deploy config to prepare (same shape as revealer/rep-4):
- host: 52.180.154.225, user: mostafa, reboot: false, sandbox: true, domain: null.
- Single BACKEND target (no frontend target).
- local: /Users/mostafaadawy/Desktop/AiAgentWorkSpace/Odin-Consolidated/_external/VolatileWorkSpace/rep5-backend
- vm: /home/mostafa/sandbox-rep5/backend  (its OWN folder — separate from revealer-sandbox and sandbox-rep4)
- port: 4200
- excludes: [".env*", "node_modules", "dist", "logs"]
- migration: "none"  => NO DB migration step on ANY deploy (this run and every future run).
- commands: ["rm -rf dist && npm run build"]  (build only — no migrate, no seed required; add a seed step only if the owner asks).

Hard sandbox invariants (same as the other sandboxes): OWN database/data, NO domain, NO nginx changes, internal port only (4200, outside the reverse-proxy range). MUST NEVER touch bendcore/organics or any production app, their DB, config, nginx, or external ports — ports 80/443 stay open to the world; firewall rotation only ever touches port 22 to a single current IP. Secrets/backups are always excluded from sync (.env*, *.key, *.pem, *.bak, .backup-env, etc.).

Deliverable of THIS task = the prepared deploy setup (the project folder + deploy/deploy-config.json + the .config.sh delta, validated against the shared engine). Do NOT execute a deploy; the owner explicitly said do not deploy now.

NOTE for the owner to confirm: backend-sandbox-rep-4 is ALREADY configured on port 4200 for vm folder /home/mostafa/sandbox-rep4/backend. You asked for 4200 again — kept verbatim. Since rep-5 uses a DIFFERENT folder they won't overwrite each other, but two services can't both bind 4200 on the same VM at the same time. See recommendations.
